description: Fetch one chat app bridge (GET /v1/bridges/{id}) with the same fields as thalovant_list_bridges: status.reason, phase, ready, applied and summary (the status in plain words), hold, the chats it answers in, and the etag the write tools accept. The platform's own diagnostic message is never included. Requires the hubs:read scope. Reads only.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

bridgeId.description: Bridge UUID: the id from thalovant_list_bridges.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_get_bridge
title: Get Chat App Bridge
